title: AIS — Resilient Lady
description: Resilient Lady (MMSI 311001056): PostgreSQL sampled position history, with a 10-second minimum sampling interval. Timestamps are UTC reception times.

panels.title: Time between stored updates

targets.rawSql:
WITH updates AS (
  SELECT received_at,
         lag(received_at) OVER (ORDER BY received_at, source_hash) AS previous_at
  FROM public.position_reports
  WHERE mmsi = '311001056' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
)
SELECT extract(epoch FROM received_at - previous_at)::double precision AS "Interval (seconds)"
FROM updates
WHERE previous_at IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Reception-time intervals between consecutive stored positions inside the selected time range. History is sampled at most once every 10 seconds; this is not a histogram of every received AIS message. The first position has no interval.

panels.title: Ground distance between stored updates

targets.rawSql:
WITH updates AS (
  SELECT position,
         lag(position) OVER (ORDER BY received_at, source_hash) AS previous_position
  FROM public.position_reports
  WHERE mmsi = '311001056' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
)
SELECT ST_Distance(position::geography, previous_position::geography) AS "Distance (metres)"
FROM updates
WHERE previous_position IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Geodesic distance in metres between consecutive stored positions inside the selected time range, calculated by PostGIS on the WGS84 spheroid. Includes zero movement and gaps in reception; this is displacement, not distance travelled along a route.

panels.title: Stored updates per hour (UTC)

targets.rawSql:
WITH hours AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('hour', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz),
    date_trunc('hour', $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
    interval '1 hour'
  ) AS hour
), counts AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) AS hour, count(*) AS updates
  FROM public.position_reports
  WHERE mmsi = '311001056' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT hours.hour AS "time", coalesce(counts.updates, 0)::double precision AS "Stored updates"
FROM hours
LEFT JOIN counts USING (hour)
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: One point per UTC hour, including hours with zero stored updates. First and last hours may be partial because counts follow the selected time range. Counts describe sampled history, not all incoming AIS messages.

panels.title: Resilient Lady positions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at AS "time", latitude, longitude,
       speed_over_ground_knots AS speed_knots
FROM public.position_reports
WHERE mmsi = '311001056' AND $__timeFilter(received_at)
ORDER BY received_at, source_hash

panels.description: Every stored position in the selected time range, without truncation. Hover for reception time, coordinates, and speed in knots. OpenStreetMap tiles require browser internet access.
